title: An exceptional guided bike tour in Barcelona
text: ! A must to discover the city in an original and pleasant way. Laurine, our guide, was at the top: passionate, dynamic and very friendly. The whole team is warm and welcoming. An experience I highly recommend!
author: VincentM949

title: Great bike tour in Barcelona!
text: Madeline was an amazing tour guide! We got to see so many great areas and spots in Barcelona that we had not yet seen! Thank you so much Madeline!
author: H4232JDelliec

title: Top visit coupled with tapas tasting.
text: A great personalized bike tour. We chose the solo and tapas formula. Good tour. Top guide who speaks French and takes the time to give explanations. The tapas bar is very good and the tapas too. So I strongly recommend
author: Vince3842

title: Amazing tour of Barcelona! ❤️😎🌴🍹
text: Superb family bike tour, the guide Corenthin knows the city perfectly and taught us many anecdotes. The quality of the bikes is exceptional and the children followed with a smile. We recommend, you will love it.
author: Q2517IXemilieb

title: Great visit to Barcelona with Born Bike!
text: I had a great experience with born bike during the Tapas tour. The Anais guide showed us around the city and taught us a lot about Barcelona’s culture and history. It was very informative! At the end of the tour, the small tapas restaurant was waiting for us; we were very well served and were able to enjoy a moment of sharing with the Born Bike team and participants. I recommend!
author: 553m_linal

title: Unmissable tour
text: The best experience we live in Barcelona, the best guide, being able to know the city with a Catalan definitely changes and improves the experience! As for tapas, the best we have tried in all of Spain 🇪🇸
